points.why: Names the shelter runs as a third outflow the spreadsheet has no entry for, so recorded stock overstates physical stock, and notes that software logging the same two flows will show the same gap.

Lists other possible unlogged losses (spoilage, untracked discards, receiving errors) and suggests a side-by-side check, but never asks systematically what else leaves each stock or recommends drawing those flows into the model.
Says to decide deliberately whether the diversion becomes an official tracked outflow, and argues that software covering only the existing categories won't close the gap.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly says to fix what the model counts by adding an outflow category before buying software.
Explicitly warns against treating volunteers as a theft problem and frames their runs as a reasonable workaround.
